teach.text: Ask one male **مِنْ أَيْنَ أَنْتَ؟** (min ayna anta?) to mean “Where are you from?”
Say **أَنَا مِنْ …** (ana min …) to mean “I am from …” Add a country after مِنْ.
**مِصْر** (miSr) means Egypt. **الْأُرْدُن** (al-urdunn) means Jordan. Country names are shown in their basic form, without a final case vowel.
**فَرَنْسَا** (faransaa) means France. For example, **أَنَا مِنْ فَرَنْسَا** means “I am from France.”

practice.prompt: Which Arabic question means “Where are you from?” when speaking to one male?
practice.explain: مِنْ أَيْنَ أَنْتَ؟ asks one male where he is from.
مِصْر is the Arabic name for Egypt.

practice.prompt: Write the Latin pronunciation of أَنَا مِنْ …
practice.explain: أَنَا مِنْ … means “I am from …” and is pronounced ana min ….

practice.prompt: Match each Arabic country name to its English meaning.
practice.explain: الْأُرْدُن means Jordan, الْمَغْرِب means Morocco, and فَرَنْسَا means France.

quiz.explain: الْمَغْرِب is the Arabic name for Morocco.

quiz.prompt: Write the Latin pronunciation of the Arabic word for Jordan.
quiz.explain: الْأُرْدُن means Jordan and is pronounced al-urdunn.

quiz.prompt: You want to say “I am from Egypt.” Which country name completes أَنَا مِنْ …?
quiz.explain: مِصْر means Egypt, so it completes the phrase meaning “I am from Egypt.”

quiz.prompt: Match each Arabic country name to its English meaning.
quiz.explain: مِصْر means Egypt, أَمْرِيكَا means America, and فَرَنْسَا means France.

quiz.prompt: أَنَا مِنْ … means “Where are you from?”
quiz.explain: أَنَا مِنْ … means “I am from …” The question is مِنْ أَيْنَ أَنْتَ؟

quiz.prompt: Which Arabic country name means Morocco?
Write the Latin pronunciation of the Arabic word for France.
quiz.explain: فَرَنْسَا means France and is pronounced faransaa.
